# Sample Incident Response Procedure (test fixture)

## 1. Purpose

This procedure defines how security incidents and AI system incidents are detected, assessed,
contained and recovered. It applies to all staff, contractors and AI agents operated by the
organization. The Incident Commander is responsible for coordinating every response.

## 2. Detection and reporting

All personnel must report suspected security events to the Security Operations team within one
hour of discovery. Automated alerts from monitoring rules and the Shield detectors are triaged
within fifteen minutes. Every reported event shall be assessed and classified as an incident or a
false positive, and the decision is recorded.

## 3. Containment and recovery

The Incident Commander may suspend any AI agent, revoke API keys and isolate affected systems.
Containment actions are approved by the Head of Security and recorded in the tamper-evident
evidence ledger with a chain of custody for collected evidence. Recovery steps are verified before
systems return to normal operation.

## 4. Communication and review

Affected customers and the regulator are notified in line with applicable requirements. A
post-incident review is held within ten working days to capture lessons learned and corrective
actions. This procedure is reviewed annually and approved by the Chief Information Security Officer.
